storyPage.lead: Khryuchik's story — the journey of a hero who grows up alongside the reader, from the first fairy tales to the big roads.

timeline.title: Khryuchik grows up alongside the reader
timeline.lead: Move the marker to walk through the series by age — from the earliest fairy tales to stories about the big roads.

chapters.title: First discoveries
chapters.blurb: Family, house rules, and the first "I can do it myself". Little Khryuchik learns to make friends, share, and say thank you.

chapters.title: Winter outside the window
chapters.blurb: Snow, grandma's pies, and a lost mitten. A story about caring for those nearby and about small miracles.

chapters.title: Summer at the cottage
chapters.blurb: Garden beds, a bicycle, a new friend across the fence. Khryuchik learns to take responsibility for what he started.

chapters.title: The big move
chapters.blurb: A new school, an unfamiliar city, and a silence that feels scary to break. The first real "I'll try anyway".

chapters.title: The road to the sea
chapters.blurb: A train, a ferry, and a salty wind. A story about a dream you reach on your own, even when it's frightening.

chapters.title: His own path
chapters.blurb: Khryuchik grows up: choices, mistakes, conversations until dawn. A book about how everyone has their own road.

series.title: One hero — two roads
series.lead: Each series is its own age and mood. You can start with either one, but it's more rewarding to go in order and grow up together with Khryuchik.

items.label: Series 1
items.name: Khryuchik when he was little
items.desc: Warm family stories, humor, first discoveries, and the big feelings of a little piglet. Books to read aloud — and to live through together.

items.label: Series 2
items.name: Khryuchik's travels
items.desc: Change, roads, new countries, and the search for oneself. The stories are based on the author's real impressions — so they smell of the sea, the train, and a real morning.

values.title: Six simple things the stories teach
values.lead: These aren't lectures. It's what Khryuchik does himself — and the reader quietly does after him.

items.title: Initiative
items.text: Khryuchik doesn't wait for things to sort themselves out. He tries, asks, takes a step.

items.title: Persistence
items.text: Didn't work — try again. Out of strength — rest and try once more.

items.title: Responsibility
items.text: If you started it — see it through. If you promised — show up.

items.title: Kindness
items.text: Small kind acts add up to a big life — that's the central plot of the series.

items.title: Optimism
items.text: There's light in any story. Sometimes you just have to be the first to notice it.

items.title: Action
items.text: Khryuchik's main lesson: between "I want" and "I did it" lies "I tried".

author.title: "I write about places and feelings I lived through myself."
author.name: Yulia Bilurka
paragraphs: Many of the cities, trains, and morning kitchens in the books are real. The author pours her experience of moving, travelling, and growing up into stories where Khryuchik lives through the same things — only funnier and a little braver than we do.
That's why "Khryuchik's travels" can be read as a guide to emotions: the fear of the new, the thrill of the first sea, the silence of an unfamiliar apartment — it's all there.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of the Khryuchik website and any purchase you make through it. By placing an order or creating an account, you agree to the terms below.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Khryuchik is currently operated by an individual seller, not a registered company. All orders, payments, and customer support are handled directly by the person operating this site. You can reach us at khryuchik@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Products and orders
paragraphs: We sell books (physical and digital) and branded merchandise. Product descriptions, images, and prices are shown on each product page and may change without prior notice.
Placing an order is an offer to buy. We confirm your order by email once it is accepted; we may decline or cancel an order if a product is unavailable, priced incorrectly, or if we suspect fraud.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
paragraphs: All prices are shown in the currency of your selected country and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Payments are processed securely by Stripe; we do not receive or store your full card number.
Depending on your country, you may also be offered cash on delivery or bank transfer as payment methods, as described on the Shipping & Payment page.

sections.heading: Shipping, returns, and refunds
paragraphs: Delivery times, shipping costs, and return conditions depend on your country and the type of product ordered (e-book, physical book, or merch). The full policy is published on our Shipping & Payment page.

If you are eligible for a refund, it is issued to your original payment method within a reasonable time after we receive and inspect the returned item, or immediately for approved e-book cancellations.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: You can check out as a guest or create an account using email/password or Google sign-in. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity under your account.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: We provide the website and products as described, but to the extent permitted by law we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of the site. Nothing in these Terms limits any statutory rights you have as a consumer that cannot be excluded by agreement.

sections.heading: Changes to these Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms from time to time, for example as the business grows or legal requirements change. The updated date at the top of this page reflects the latest revision; continued use of the site after a change means you accept the updated Terms.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about an order or these Terms? Email us at khryuchik@gmail.com.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Khryuchik collects when you use this website, why we collect it, and the choices and rights you have.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: Khryuchik is currently operated by an individual seller, not a registered company. For any privacy question or request, contact khryuchik@gmail.com — we will respond as the party responsible for handling your data.

sections.heading: Data we collect
paragraphs: Account data: name, email address, and password (stored securely hashed) if you register, or your name and email from Google if you sign in with Google.
Order data: shipping address, contact details, order contents, and order status, needed to fulfill and support your purchase.
Payment data: handled directly by Stripe. We never see or store your full card number; we only receive confirmation that a payment succeeded or failed.
Technical data: your selected country and language preference, stored in cookies, and basic request information needed to keep the site secure and functioning.

sections.heading: How we use your data
paragraphs: To process and deliver your orders, send order confirmations and shipping updates, respond to support requests, and let you sign in and manage your account and order history.

sections.heading: Who we share data with
paragraphs: Stripe, to process payments. Google, if you choose to sign in with your Google account. Our email provider, to send transactional emails such as order confirmations and password resets.
We also receive an internal notification in a private Telegram chat when a new order is placed, so we can fulfill it promptly — this is for our own order handling only and is not used for marketing.
We do not sell your personal data, and we do not share it with advertisers.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use essential cookies only: to keep you signed in, to remember your selected country and language, and to keep your shopping cart working. We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies at this time.

sections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep order and account data for as long as needed to fulfill orders, handle returns, and meet any applicable tax or accounting record-keeping requirements, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: International data transfers
paragraphs: Some of our service providers (such as Stripe, Google, and our database and hosting infrastructure) may process data outside your country of residence. Where required, we rely on the safeguards these providers offer for cross-border transfers.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or export a copy of your personal data, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent at any time.
To exercise any of these rights, email khryuchik@gmail.com. If you are in the EU/EEA, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Khryuchik sells children's books, but the website itself is intended for use by adults who place orders on behalf of children. We do not knowingly collect personal data directly from children.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy as our practices evolve or legal requirements change. The updated date at the top of this page reflects the latest revision.

productForm.footerDescription: Review the product data and create the product card.

helpers.productId: Leave empty to generate it automatically.
helpers.slug: Leave empty to generate it from the EN title and normalize it for URLs.
helpers.sku: Leave empty to generate it automatically from the product ID.
helpers.relatedProductIds: Start typing a title, ID, or slug and pick products from the list.
helpers.storyProductId: Pick the book or product that should supply the title and thumbnail for the story block.
helpers.mediaRule: The first image is used as the thumbnail. The rest become the gallery.
helpers.optionsRule: Type a value and press Enter.
helpers.optionPriceDeltaRule: Added to the region base price when the value is selected. Leave empty when the value costs the same.
helpers.languagesSelectRule: Select the languages the book is written in.
helpers.formatsRule: Select the formats the book is available in.
helpers.specsRule: Add specifications as separate fields with a name and a value.
helpers.reviewsRule: Reviews are shared across all product locales.
helpers.filesRule: Upload one PDF file. A new upload will replace the existing one.

productForm.printifySectionDescription: Variants come from Printify. Pricing and copy stay under your control here.
productForm.printifyImportedMessage: Imported from Printify. Check the category — it is only a default. Then set the price, regions and translations and make it visible.
productForm.printifyManagedStock: Managed by Printify — updated on sync

printify.title: Import from Printify
printify.description: Pull merch and gifts from the connected Printify shop into the catalogue.
printify.emptyDescription: Create a product in Printify first, then import it here.
printify.loadFailed: Could not load products from Printify. Check PRINTIFY_API_TOKEN and PRINTIFY_SHOP_ID.
